description: Synthetic second reading, made from the real tape in fixtures/published-2026-11-11-0808 (every time moved 1800 s later): the chain went on, finalized block 3457787 under the hash 0xd1...d1, best 3457791, and its runtime spec version is 1014013, below the 1014014 the log holds. Then, as a run on a log holding that real reading does, it reads back the anchor, block 3457487, the latest finalized head the log holds, with chain_getBlockHash(3457487), and the node gives the hash the log holds. It is read on top of a log holding that real reading.
